'''Santa Claus''', also known as '''Saint Nick''', was a [[Color/Legends|white]]-[[Hair/Legends|bearded]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. He was known for his tradition of delivering presents to the "good" [[Youngling/Legends|children]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|annual]] holiday of [[Christmas]] upon a [[Sled/Legends|sleigh]] pulled by eight [[Reindeer/Legends|reindeer]]. Eventually, Claus retired from his job and instead enlisted his son, [[S. Claus]], to take up the job. Santa was present at various locations around the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], such as [[Goodvalor's Little Bivoli]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and on the [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
===Delivering presents===
Also known as Saint Nick, Santa Claus was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="SantaStarWars.com" /> On the [[Standard day/Legends|morning]] of the [[Standard year/Legends|annual]] holiday of [[Christmas]], he would visit [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-run [[Factory/Legends|factories]] to retrieve toys<ref name="Christmas">''[[Christmas in the Stars]]''</ref> to distribute among the [[Youngling/Legends|children]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] whom he deemed "good" by entering through their chimneys. To complete this journey, Claus would take use of his [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]]<ref name="SantaStarWars.com" /> but would additionally employ the use of a [[Sled/Legends|sleigh]] pulled by eight [[Reindeer/Legends|reindeer]]: [[Dasher]], [[Dancer (reindeer)|Dancer]], [[Prancer]], [[Vixen]], [[Comet (reindeer)|Comet]], [[Cupid]], [[Dunder]], and [[Blixem]].<ref name="Christmas" /> One of Claus's fellow Jedi,<ref name="SantaStarWars.com" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]<ref name="Legendary Yoda">''[[Star Wars: The Legendary Yoda]]''</ref> [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]],<ref name="Forty Years">{{SW|url=news/from-mcquarrie-to-chiang-highlights-from-40-years-of-lucasfilm-star-wars-holiday-cards|text=From McQuarrie to Chiang: Highlights from 40 Years of Lucasfilm ''Star Wars'' Holiday Cards|nolive=1}}</ref> donned regalia similar to Claus's distinctive outfit on at least one occasion.<ref name="Adventure Journal">[[Star Wars Adventure Journal 8|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 8]]</ref>

In [[3963 BBY]], Santa Claus attended the dining establishment [[Goodvalor's Little Bivoli]] on the<ref name="KOTOR" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="KOTOR" /> At some point, he had a [[Gender/Legends|son]] named [[S. Claus]].<ref name="Christmas" />

===Retirement and Galactic Civil War===
Eventually, Santa became unable to deliver gifts during Christmas and enlisted his son to take over. As such, Santa and S. Claus were often confused as both were rarely seen by the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] citizenry. The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] claimed that he once watched as Santa, whom he mistook for S. Claus, collected toys from a factory in which C-3PO worked, loading them aboard his sleigh to distribute during Christmas.<ref name="Christmas" />

During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Santa Claus was present onboard the Rebel [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Home One type Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']] with his sack of presents.<ref name="X-Wing">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Santa Claus was a short<ref name="Christmas" /> and light-skinned, [[Color/Legends|white]]-[[Hair/Legends|bearded]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]].<ref name="KOTOR" /> According to C-3PO, Santa had a round stomach, twinkling [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], merry cheeks, and a [[Bow-tie|bow]]-shaped mouth.<ref name="Christmas" />

==Powers and abilities==
Claus had access to [[The Force/Legends|Force]] powers that would allow him to travel around the galaxy in a single morning.<ref name="SantaStarWars.com" />

==Equipment==
Santa dressed in a red-and-white<ref name="KOTOR" /> [[Hair/Legends|fur]]<ref name="Christmas" /> outfit with a [[Hat/Legends|hat]],<ref name="KOTOR" /> black [[Boot/Legends|boots]], and a [[Belt/Legends|belt]]. When delivering gifts, Santa carried around a brown sack in which to place them.<ref name="X-Wing" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ChristmasintheStars.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The cover of ''Christmas in the Stars'', on which Santa is depicted]]
In the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe, Santa Claus was first mentioned in and pictured on the cover of ''[[Christmas in the Stars]]'',<ref name="Christmas">''[[Christmas in the Stars]]''</ref> a [[Canon|non-canon]] [[1980]] [[Wikipedia:Christmas|Christmas]] album produced by [[Wikipedia:RSO Records|RSO Records]] that featured ''Star Wars''&ndash;themed Christmas songs.<ref name="Trick Question">{{SW|url=news/when-it-comes-to-christmas-music-is-there-anything-better-than-christmas-in-the-stars-trick-question|text=When it Comes to Christmas Music, Is There Anything Better Than ''Christmas in the Stars''? (Trick Question!)}}</ref> In the real world, [[Wikipedia:Santa Claus|Santa Claus]] is a Christmas legend who is said to bring gifts to children on [[Wikipedia:Christmas Eve|Christmas Eve]].<ref name="SantaRealLife">{{WebCite|url=https://www.history.com/topics/christmas/santa-claus|text=Santa Claus: Real Origins & Legend |date=2010-02-16|work=[[Wikipedia:History (American TV network)|History.com]]|archivedate=20230106095025}}</ref>

A number of [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO ''Star Wars'']] sets in the "''Star Wars'' Advent Calendar" line contain minifigures of ''Star Wars'' characters dressed as Santa Claus, including Yoda<ref name="Lego">{{LEGOCite|num=7958|name=Star Wars Advent Calendar}}</ref> and the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]<ref name="Lego1">{{LEGOCite|num=9509|name=Star Wars Advent Calendar}}</ref> and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="Lego2">{{LEGOCite|num=75056|name=Star Wars Advent Calendar}}</ref> Concept designer [[Ralph McQuarrie]] drew a set of ''Star Wars'' holiday cards between [[1978]] and [[1994]] that were distributed to [[Lucasfilm]] business partners, two of which included Yoda dressed as Santa,<ref name="Forty Years" /> with one of these going on to feature on the cover of the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 8|eighth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'', which was published in [[November]] [[1995]].<ref name="Adventure Journal" /> In the [[2006]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy]]'', entering the codes "CL4U5H" and "TYH319" at the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]] and activating Disguise 3 in the Extras menu allows the player to create a [[:File:LegoSanta.jpg|Santa-like character]] in the character customizer.<ref name="LSW2">''[[LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy]]''</ref> This character was identified as Santa Claus in a [[StarWars.com]] news item.<ref name="SantaStarWars.com" /> In [[2011]],<ref name="Kerbobble">{{WebCite|url=https://kerbobble-toys.com/products/sideshow-collectibles-star-wars-holiday-yoda|text=Sideshow Collectibles Star Wars Holiday Yoda|work=[https://kerbobble-toys.com kerbobble-toys.com]|archivedate=20240916165347}}</ref> [[Sideshow Collectibles]] made a "Holiday Yoda" figure based on a [[1981]] Lucasfilm holiday card.<ref name="Insider179">{{InsiderCite|179|Yoda: A Luminous Being Is He}}</ref>

Santa also appears in the [[1993]] computer game [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]; when the date is set to [[December 25]]<ref name="X-Wing" />&mdash;the date of Christmas<ref name="Date of Christmas">{{WebCite|url=https://www.history.com/topics/christmas/why-december-25th-video|text=Why December 25th |work=[[Wikipedia:History (American TV network)|History.com]]|archivedate=20221212180335}}</ref>&mdash;in the Collector's CD-ROM version, Santa Claus [[:File:IndependenceSantaClaus.png|appears]] on the ''Independence'' concourse menu.<ref name="X-Wing" />
